title: Choose Wayfinder's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Tool Library Shadow Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Tool Library Shadow Board
options.lineage: makerspace tool libraries and pegboard shadow boards
options.thesis: Every option hangs on a shadow board: what fits fills its outline, what is unknown stays an empty outline.
options.viewport: Pegboard-green rail with the eight steps; Dana's options as rows of constraint slots; the selected option's evidence tags on the right.
options.risk: Reads as a hardware-store theme if the outlines decorate instead of carrying constraint state.

raised.raise: Every row, slot, and tag snaps to one hairline grid with registered corners.
Narrow widths reflow whole constraint slots, never squeeze them.
Hierarchy comes from scale contrast alone: one large size for the option, one small size for the rest.
One exhaustive state vocabulary: filled outline meets, red tag conflicts, empty dashed outline unknown.

options.label: Customs Declaration
options.thesis: What leaves is itemized on a declaration, and every claim carries a postmark saying where it came from.
options.viewport: Ways forward as an itemized manifest; each claim stamped Inferred, Public source, or Member intention; live or replay as the cancellation mark.
options.risk: The most familiar paper-ephemera move for privacy products; airmail stripes can slide into costume.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.thesis: Public, member, and combined options are three lines converging on one destination: the intention.
options.viewport: The run as a line diagram across the top; options listed as stations with interchange circles where member meets public.
options.case: Holds audience identification, everyone reads a metro map; loses on clarity because it leans on the product name.
options.risk: A literal reading of the Wayfinder name, and the dark ground pulls toward the terminal look the brief rules out.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Wallet
options.lineage: airline ticket coupons and baggage tags
options.thesis: The flow is a coupon book: each step tears off, and hard conflicts get stamped VOID instead of disappearing.
options.viewport: Options as coupons with carbon-struck constraint fields; excluded ones stamped VOID; introduction states validate on the stub.
options.case: Holds clarity, since coupon states map to introduction states; loses audience because travel imagery makes Wayfinder read as a travel app.
options.risk: Project rules keep travel an example only; this world says travel first.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.thesis: Sections as coloured divider boards under clear acetate leaves.
options.viewport: A stepped tab rail down the edge, one tab per step.
options.case: Members do not identify with software manuals, and plies make provenance harder to read.
options.kept: An exhaustive state vocabulary with one mark per state.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.thesis: A near-white sheet with registration crosses and one stamp.
options.viewport: Options as plates with credit rows.
options.case: Reads as an editorial page, the broadsheet look this category already defaults to.
options.risk: Gallery posture on a working screen.
options.kept: A whole grid built from hairlines with registered corners.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Letterforms built cell by cell on a visible grid.
options.viewport: A monumental headline over a visible grid.
options.case: Monumental type competes with the options it should serve.
options.kept: Reflow by whole cells as width changes.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.thesis: Axis sliders morph a grid of glyphs.
options.viewport: One giant glyph and a slider.
options.case: Nothing in the product is about type; the world has no job here.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean AI-product app, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar of steps, a card list of options with coloured badges, a detail drawer.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other AI product by design.
